experiment: Piotr independent pre/post teacher information diagnostic, primary200
charge_scope: All600 primary/repeat calls plus up to20 diagnosed failed-request retries; unused cap is not a target.
selection: One random transition per task group; deterministic seed42; no outcome conditioning.
isolation: All200 primary task groups and normalized goals exclude all40 calibration groups plus protected validation/retention and benchmarks. No critic fitting.
requested_outputs: paired label transition matrix and flip fraction
limitations: Disagreement is not evidence of higher accuracy.
No alternative actions executed or episode-return labels fabricated.
Pixel changes and execution success do not imply goal progress.
No paid reference judge is included; evidence-support audit is separate and cannot be treated as full-panel ground truth.
Prior studies budgets are not transferred.
Self-imposed dollar ceiling can halt the panel if input lengths exceed observed cost estimates.

protocol.sample: 200 new task groups, one transition per group; disjoint40 calibration; seed42
primary_metrics: mean absolute and signed P(progress)-P(regression) change
task-paired excess absolute change over mean pre/post repeat variability
protocol.intervals: 10000 task bootstrap resamples, seed42; Wilson for binomial fractions as supplementary

evidence_review.method: Qualitative local independent review of all changed primary cases plus20 randomly selected unchanged controls; no additional paid judge calls. Reviewer sees full observed evidence without teacher labels/rationales, records an evidence-based reference with abstention, then compares to both judgments.
evidence_review.cautions: Selected review set is not representative accuracy. Single reviewer is not ground truth; preserve unresolved and distinguish direct execution effects from semantic progress.
